title.narrative: PROMOTION OF GENDER RESPONSIVE AND DISABILITY INCLUSIVE EDUCATION THROUGH SPECIALISED PEDAGOGICAL SKILLS TRAINING FOR TEACHERS IN PRIMARY SCHOOLS

description.narrative: The project has been designed to promote inclusive education where girls with disabilities are gaining the same level of quality education as boys with disabilities, and their non-disabled peers. This will include strengthening the gender responsive technical capacity of teachers in Primary Schools to promote gender responsive special needs and inclusive education. As we strive to achieve SDG 4 targets, approaches identified in the project include providing gender-responsive, inclusive education training for teachers, which addresses the intersectional needs of girls and boys with disabilities and includes instruction in gender-responsive, inclusive pedagogy, using support personnel, such as Centre Coordinating Tutors, senior women and male teachers and special needs education officials. These educators are responsible for supporting learners with disabilities and are often an integral part of delivering inclusive teaching in schools and ensuring children with disabilities can attend mainstream schools. Working with existing community structures, families, and organizations of persons with disabilities to understand and address negative attitudes, beliefs, and practices around gender and disability and empower women and girls with disabilities to share and normalize their experiences. The intervention will promote gender-responsive pedagogy focused at leaners with special needs and such mechanism should be incorporated into any pedagogical reform initiatives in Schools to ensure that the needs of both female and male leaners with special needs are met and that they will benefit equally from improved teaching and learning practices.
